# RepoRise
> Zero-dependency repository visibility toolkit for SEO, AEO, and GEO.

RepoRise audits open-source repositories to measure how findable, extractable, and citable they are across search engines (SEO), direct answer engines (AEO), and generative AI engines (GEO).

## Core Capabilities
- Visibility Audit: 22 offline heuristics checking identity, citability, discoverability, answerability, and hygiene.
- Citation Probe: Empirical sampling of generative engines with 95% Wilson confidence intervals.
- Zero dependencies: Runs entirely offline on Node >= 18 with no runtime dependencies, no API keys, and no telemetry.

## Quick CLI Usage
- Run offline audit: `npx reporise .`
- Audit for CI quality gate: `npx reporise . --fail-under 80`
- Probe status: `node skills/citation-probe/scripts/probe.mjs status .`

## Key Files & Structure
- `skills/visibility-audit/`: Self-contained offline audit skill and CLI runner.
- `skills/citation-probe/`: Self-contained citation probe skill with Wilson score statistics.
- `benchmarks/`: Benchmark registry and cryptographic provenance manifest.
- `README.md`: Getting started, installation matrix, and full check definitions.
